name: 毒素陷阱
description: 当敌方棋子移动到毒素格子时，受到4点真实伤害并消耗毒素
skillCode: var mover = context.sourcePiece; if (!mover || mover.currentHp <= 0) return { success: false, message: '' }; if (mover.ownerPlayerId === context.playerId) return { success: false, message: '' }; var player = battle.players.find(function(p) { return p.playerId === context.playerId; }); if (!player || !player.statusTags) return { success: false, message: '' }; var toxins = player.statusTags.filter(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'lethal-toxin'; }); if (!toxins.length) { removePlayerRuleById(context.playerId, 'rule-blackwidow-toxin-player'); return { success: false, message: '' }; } var toxinTag = toxins.find(function(tag) { return mover.x === tag.value && mover.y === tag.extraValue; }); if (!toxinTag) return { success: false, message: '' }; var damage = toxinTag.intensity || 4; var casterPiece = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === toxinTag.sourceId && p.currentHp > 0; }) || battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.ownerPlayerId === context.playerId && p.currentHp > 0; }); dealDamage(casterPiece || mover, mover, damage, 'true', battle, 'lethal-toxin'); if (battle.extensions && battle.extensions.tileEffects) battle.extensions.tileEffects = battle.extensions.tileEffects.filter(function(effect) { return !(effect.tileType === 'lethal-toxin' && effect.sourceId === toxinTag.id); }); removePlayerStatusEffectById(context.playerId, toxinTag.id); if (!player.statusTags.some(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'lethal-toxin'; })) removePlayerRuleById(context.playerId, 'rule-blackwidow-toxin-player'); return { success: true, message: mover.name + '触发了致命毒素，受到' + damage + '点真实伤害！' };
